_meta.doc: User-facing error catalog. Add an entry for any error code returned by the backend so the frontend can show a friendly toast instead of a raw code. Severity drives the visual treatment: 'info' (blue), 'warning' (yellow), 'error' (red). Unknown codes fall back to the raw message; that's a signal to add an entry here.

network.title: Couldn't reach the machine
network.what_happened: The browser couldn't talk to the Cardomancer server.
network.what_to_try: Check that the Cardomancer service is running and that you're on the same network. Reload this page to retry.

not_connected.title: Hardware not connected
not_connected.what_happened: The controller is offline. Cardomancer can't move the head or pick a card without it.
not_connected.what_to_try: Open Setup → Hardware → Connect, or check that the USB cable is plugged in.

busy.title: Cardomancer is busy
busy.what_happened: Another action is in progress. Cardomancer queued one operation at a time so they don't fight.
busy.what_to_try: Wait a moment for the current step to finish, then try again.

estopped.title: Emergency stop active
estopped.what_happened: Cardomancer halted because the emergency stop was pressed.
estopped.what_to_try: Make sure nothing is blocking the carriage, then click "Reset & Re-home" in the top bar.

camera_not_active.title: Camera isn't running
camera_not_active.what_happened: Cardomancer needs a live camera feed to identify cards, and the feed isn't on.
camera_not_active.what_to_try: Open Setup → Camera → Start, then re-run this action.

no_frame_available.title: Camera didn't return an image
no_frame_available.what_happened: The camera is on but Cardomancer didn't get a frame in time.
no_frame_available.what_to_try: Check that the lens is unblocked and that the camera USB cable is seated. If the issue persists, run Setup → Run diagnostics.

no_bins_configured.title: No destination bins set up
no_bins_configured.what_happened: Cardomancer doesn't know where to drop cards yet.
no_bins_configured.what_to_try: Open Sort → configure your bin queries and bin positions before starting a session.

no_source_configured.title: No source bin set up
no_source_configured.what_happened: Cardomancer doesn't know where to pick cards from.
no_source_configured.what_to_try: Open Setup → Calibration and run the ArUco calibration to set the source-bin position.

no_staging_configured.title: No staging platform set up
no_staging_configured.what_happened: Cardomancer can't drop cards on staging for the camera to see — the platform isn't calibrated.
no_staging_configured.what_to_try: Open Setup → Calibration and run the calibration wizard so Cardomancer learns where the platform is.

hash_db_missing.title: Card data missing
hash_db_missing.what_happened: The art-hash database Cardomancer uses to recognize cards isn't on disk.
hash_db_missing.what_to_try: Open Settings (gear icon) → Database → Update card data. If you're on a fresh install, this download is required before sorting.

cards_db_missing.title: Card metadata missing
cards_db_missing.what_happened: The Scryfall card metadata file isn't on disk, so Cardomancer can't look up identified cards.
cards_db_missing.what_to_try: Open Settings (gear icon) → Database → Update card data.

homing_failed.title: Homing failed
homing_failed.what_happened: Cardomancer tried to home the axes but the move didn't complete.
homing_failed.what_to_try: Check that the carriage moves freely and the limit switches are wired. Run Setup → Run diagnostics for a step-by-step check.

config_not_found.title: Sort preset not found
config_not_found.what_happened: Cardomancer couldn't find the sort preset by that name.
config_not_found.what_to_try: Pick another preset from the dropdown, or create a new one from the Sort tab.

invalid_content.title: Sort preset is malformed
invalid_content.what_happened: The preset content didn't parse — there's a syntax error in one of the bin queries.
invalid_content.what_to_try: Check the preset for typos. Each bin needs a number and a query, e.g. "bin1: c:r".

target_exists.title: Preset name already exists
target_exists.what_happened: A preset with that name is already saved.
target_exists.what_to_try: Pick a different name, or load the existing preset and edit it.

missing_session_id.title: Missing session ID
missing_session_id.what_happened: Cardomancer needed a session ID to complete this action but didn't get one.
missing_session_id.what_to_try: Reload the page and try again. If this keeps happening, mention this code (missing_session_id) in your support note.

_default.title: Something went wrong
_default.what_happened: Cardomancer hit an error it doesn't have a friendly explanation for yet.
_default.what_to_try: Try the action again. If it keeps failing, copy the technical details (below) into a support note.
